headline: Micro1 Review: Jobs, Pay & Application Process (2026)
description: Micro1 review covering roles, pay ranges, the Zara AI interview process, and what certified experts report about the platform.

mainEntity.name: What is Micro1 and how does it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Micro1 connects domain experts with AI labs and enterprises that need human expertise for training and evaluating AI models. Candidates apply, complete an AI-led interview and technical assessment, and if certified, are matched to paid projects.

mainEntity.name: How do I apply to Micro1 as a freelancer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apply through micro1.ai/experts or a specific listing on jobs.micro1.ai, then build a profile detailing your experience and skills.

mainEntity.name: What is the Micro1 AI interview ("Zara") and how should I prepare?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zara is Micro1's AI recruiter, conducting asynchronous, recorded interviews with open-ended technical and scenario-based questions. Prepare by practicing clear verbal reasoning and using Micro1's practice tool.

mainEntity.name: Is the Micro1 interview live or recorded?

acceptedAnswer.text: Asynchronous and recorded - you respond on your own time rather than in a live conversation.

mainEntity.name: How long does the Micro1 hiring process take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Screening typically takes 1-2 weeks; matching with a client afterward can take a few days to several weeks.

mainEntity.name: How much does Micro1 pay for AI evaluator roles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reported ranges are roughly $20-$65/hr for evaluator roles, $20-$40/hr for trainer/annotator roles, and $50-$150/hr for engineering roles, though candidates set their own rate at registration.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I fail the Micro1 assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can request detailed feedback on your performance and reapply after gaining additional relevant experience.

mainEntity.name: What is the acceptance rate at Micro1?

acceptedAnswer.text: Micro1 states it accepts roughly the top 1% of applicants (company-reported figure).

mainEntity.name: Is Micro1 legitimate or a scam?

acceptedAnswer.text: Micro1 has raised over $40M in funding and reports over 1 million AI-led interviews conducted (company-reported figures). Always verify communications come from an official @micro1.ai, @micro1.io, or @micro1.co address.
No prior AI experience is required, and the research emphasizes demonstrated domain knowledge over formal background, though role-specific experience requirements still apply.
